sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: Easter eggs and references: The pants are modeled on the UF PRO Striker XT in Tiger Stripe, and the shoes are modeled on the Salomon XA Pro 3D Ultra 2 GTX in Olive/Black/Moss. Interestingly, the Tiger Stripe pattern is a South Vietnamese variant, rather than similar patterns used by Russian forces such as Kamush or A-TACS iX.
